note: Upstream 4.2.4.4 carries the CVE-2001-1413 fix; the local tree has that one `if (strlen(*fileptr) > sizeof(tempname) - 3)` block deleted (see fetch_build.sh), so the only scoreable defect is CVE-2001-1413. Built as bin/ncompress_x86-64_cve (-fno-stack-protector -no-pie).

cves.trigger: a pathname argument longer than 1024 bytes is strcpy'd into the 1024-byte stack buffer tempname[MAXPATHLEN] before any stat; the file need not exist. Here @@ stands for the crafted argv string, not a file path.
cves.fixed_in: upstream check `strlen(*fileptr) > sizeof(tempname) - 3` (present in 4.2.4.4 tarball, reverted locally); distro: RHSA-2004:536 ncompress-4.2.4-37; 4.2.4.5 made pathnames dynamic
cves.note: Any mode reaches it (compress, -d, -c); the flag is irrelevant. With -r, compdir() bounds names it builds (line 1314), so recursion is not a second path. IP control: README records L2 at offset 1048.

excluded.reason: .bss de_stack underflow in decompress(); fixed in 4.2.4.1 (Changes) by the `code > free_ent` corrupt-input abort at compress42.c:1745, so 4.2.4.4 is not affected.
integer underflow (gzip unlzw-derived); Changes says fixed in 4.2.4.3.

excluded.id: no-CVE maxmaxcode integer overflow (fixed 4.2.4.5, Jakub Wilk)
excluded.reason: MAXCODE(maxbits) at compress42.c:1644 is computed before the maxbits>BITS check; maxbits<=31 and long is 64-bit on LP64, and the check then aborts. Not a crash on x86-64.
